newsitem.title: USA: US Treasuries end lower, profit-taking cited.
newsitem.headline: US Treasuries end lower, profit-taking cited.

text.p: *US Treasuries end down. Profit-taking ends 4-day winning streak.
*Fed says FOMC voted 11-1 to keep U.S. rates steady on August 20.
*Minneapolis Fed's Stern dissented, citing inflation concern.
*U of Mich sentiment slips. Q2 GDP revised down to 4.7 pct.
*Market eyes Sept payrolls, due Oct 3. 166,000 new jobs forecast.
